text:
jessica: Hey team — AcmeCorp reporting repeated 503s from our hosted inference endpoints over the last 30m. They see it spike when their service does auth refresh churn. customer says SDK retries are creating a loop. link to ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/ACME-789
support-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-311 (assigned to eng-support). Initial priority P1 due to customer production impact. :rotating_light:
devon: Can you paste a short repro or logs? Is it only one region?
jessica: USW2 only so far. Key log snippet from their app (redacted):
```
2026-03-17T14:02:10Z ERROR request failed status=503 upstream_error="connection reset by peer" url="/v1/generate"
2026-03-17T14:02:10Z WARN retrying attempt=1 client_retry=true
2026-03-17T14:02:11Z ERROR request failed status=503 upstream_error="timeout" url="/v1/generate"
```
They say failures cluster around token refresh windows when many clients re-auth simultaneously.
ops-li: Thanks — sounds like auth token refresh fanout + edge connection exhaustion. Can we confirm our auth service (token endpoint) is seeing a spike too?
jessica: Attaching auth edge metrics from customer span: concurrent token refresh requests jumped from ~20 to ~1.2k in a 45s window.
support-bot: Note: logged spike metrics to #observability for correlation.
samir: If the client retries aggressively without jitter, it can amplify. Ask them to instrument exponential backoff with random jitter as a stopgap. Also we should check gateway keepalive and per-conn max streams on the proxy.
devon: Repro steps I asked them to run: send 200 parallel requests with short TTL token and concurrent token refresh simulated. They provided curl example: 
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do \
  (curl -s -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SHORT_LIVED_TOKEN\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}' & )\
done
wait
```
This reproduces 503 bursts within ~30s for them.
ops-li: On our side I see p95 connection queue growth on the USW2 edge at 14:02:xx matching their timestamps. Could be upstream pool exhaustion to inference hosts when auth backend briefly stalls. We should temporarily throttle auth refreshes per-customer at the edge.
samir: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: add a soft token refresh rate limit per API key (burst allowed, then 1 req/s). Also enable short token caching at the gateway so repeated auth checks don't fan out. Can we roll that out as a config change?
devon: Ops, can you apply a per-key refresh throttle gate to the USW2 ingress? I can flip a feature flag for 30m window.
ops-li: I can enable the gate for the customer's API key now. Rolling config to USW2 in 2m. Will monitor error rate.
support-bot: Change applied: feature-flag auth-refresh-throttle:true -> USW2 for key=acct_acmecorp. Monitoring enabled.
(2m later)
ops-li: Update: after throttle, AcmeCorp 5xx rate dropped 85% within 3m. Connection queue cleared. p95 latency returned to normal.
jessica: Customer update draft: "We've identified a refresh-fanout issue at the edge causing transient 503s. We've applied a temporary per-key throttle which reduced errors; we're working on a permanent fix to cache token validations and smooth refresh windows. We'll follow up with a postmortem." Thoughts?
pm-aaron: LGTM. Add ETA for permanent fix: "targeting a durable fix by 2026-03-24 with a follow-up PM/eng writeup." Also offer proactive rate-limiter guidance for their SDK.
samir: For permanent fix, engineering will: 1) add gateway token validation caching (TTL ~30s) 2) increase edge upstream connection pool and add circuit-breaker for auth backend 3) add SDK sample for jittered backoff + batching refreshes. Estimate ~1 week to rollout and validate.
devon: I'll open an internal task and assign owners. Also adding test harness to simulate auth refresh fanouts with the chaos runner.
jessica: Customer notified. They asked for short-term mitigation logs to verify — sent them the incident dashboard link and flag change. They replied: "observed drop in 503s, thanks — will keep monitoring." :thumbsup:
ops-li: Will follow up tomorrow with metric snapshots. Marking incident as mitigated but keep ticket open until perm fix complete.
support-bot: Follow-up tasks created: TSK-5421 (gateway token cache), TSK-5422 (edge pool + cb tuning), TSK-5423 (SDK backoff examples). Assigned with due dates.
jessica: Thanks team. Closing thread for now. If anything spikes, re-open.
